name: opencode-session-manager
description: OpenCode session manager: the in-app plugin (session ID under the sidebar title, the session-id tool, /transfer-session) and an offline maintenance CLI for opencode.db (verified compaction, migration, rollback); strict hexagonal, Bun, v2 and v1 hosts

scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:component && bun run test:e2e && bun run test:live
scripts.coverage: bun run coverage:unit && bun run coverage:e2e
scripts.install:plugin:v1: bun run build && bun scripts/install-plugin.mjs v1
scripts.install:plugin:v2: bun run build && bun scripts/install-plugin.mjs v2
scripts.install:cli: bun run build && bun scripts/install-cli.mjs install
